jobs_results.title: INGENIERO DE SOFTWARE
jobs_results.description:
Hemos estado desarrollando nuestro software de gestión hotelera SIHOT desde 1986 y hoy en día la empresa cuenta con más de 3.500 hoteles como clientes por todo el mundo. Nuestras oficinas están ubicadas al lado de Berlín, en Valencia, Lisboa, Cardiff, San Paulo y en la Costa Dorada de Australia y cuentan con el total de 200 empleados.

¡Forma parte de la corporación internacional y plantéate nuevos desafíos! En nuestra oficina en Valencia, estamos contratando Ingenieros de Software calificados para que se unan a nuestro departamento de Desarrollo.

TUS TAREAS
• Trabajar en el desarrollo y mantenimiento continuo de nuestro software estándar SIHOT utilizando enfoques analíticos y conceptuales.
• Producir e implementar diseños de software de acuerdo con las especificaciones proporcionadas.
• Transformar los diseños y especificaciones de software en código de alto funcionamiento.
• Colaborar con los escritores de los documentos técnicos para crear la documentación de gestión interna de la... calidad y el soporte al usuario

TU PERFIL
• BSc / BA en informática, ingeniería de software o disciplina relacionada
• Experiencia comprobada como programador o puesto relacionado
• Capacidad para programar en lenguajes como C ++ / C # o similar y sus tecnologías relacionadas
• El conocimiento obligatorio de sistemas de bases de datos
• Habilidad para comunicarse en inglés, tanto verbal como escrito

BENEFICIOS

APLICA AHORA

¿Parece que esto es exactamnete lo que estás buscando?

Por favor, envíanos tu solicitud detallada junto con tus expectativas salariales y la fecha cuándo podrías empezar a Sr. Christoph Haack, jobs-es@sihot.com.

Características del Puesto

Categoría de Puesto
Desarrollo de software

Funktionsbereich
Desarrollo de Software

Standort
Valencia

Anstellungsart
Jornada completa

jobs_results.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Localidad : Barcelona

Provincia : Barcelona

País : España

Empresa : Segula Technologies

Nº Vacantes (puestos) : 1

Tipo de oferta : Empleado/a Jornada completa

Descripción

¿Quieres formar parte de una empresa innovadora, presente en sectores tan importantes como automoción, rail, energético o aeroespacial entre otros? Desde SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES estamos buscando a gente como tú. La compañía ha experimentado un rápido crecimiento en los últimos años y actualmente estamos presentes en más de 30 países con más de 15.000 empleados/as. Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en todas las etapas del ciclo de vida del producto. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES cuenta con un amplio equipo de expertos/as de ingeniería diseño, modelado y simulación, así como tecnologías digitales. Trabajamos en un ambiente inclusivo y respetuoso, donde todas las personas son valoradas y tienen igualdad de oportunidades para desarrollar su potencial.

Funciones

Grupo SEGULA, líder internacional en el sector de la Ingeniería y... Consultoría de alto valor añadido con una plantilla de 15.000 técnicos en 30 países, precisamos incorporar Software Development Engineer para unirse a nuestro equipo, en casa de cliente Barcelona.
• Integrar tanto herramientas de software de bajo nivel (sistemas pseudo-embbeded) como de alto nivel (backoffice).
• Utilizar la iniciativa para investigar y aprender de manera independiente, cuestionar suposiciones y desafiar resultados.
• Cooperar con el equipo para definir, escribir y analizar los requisitos del producto de software/hardware.
• Entregar valor al cliente de manera interactiva mientras se trabaja hacia sistemas a largo plazo para resolver los objetivos de la hoja de ruta con mayor eficiencia.
• Comunicar el estado y los cambios del trabajo del cual son responsables, mantener informados a todos los interesados de los cambios y actualizaciones al plan original.
• Implementar automatización de pruebas en todo el código implementado a través de pruebas unitarias y pruebas de integración.

Requisitos
• Grado, maestría o doctorado en arquitectura de software, ingeniería informática, ingeniería electrónica o un campo relacionado.
• Experiencia en administración y programación con sistemas Linux.
• Experiencia programando en lenguaje moderno como C/C++ y Python.
• Conocimiento de fundamentos de ciencias de la computación como, machine learning y POO, diseño de algoritmos, estructuras de datos, resolución de problemas y análisis de complejidad.
• Ingles imprescindible, francés valorable.
• Conocimientos y un fuerte interés en arquitecturas de software.
• Una actitud proactiva y colaborativa, demostrando entusiasmo por aprender, explorar nuevas ideas y contribuir como un miembro valioso de un equipo dedicado y dinámico.

Se ofrece
• Contrato indefinido.
• Trabajo hibrido y horario de oficina flexible.
• Paquete SEGULA Benefits: seguro de salud, guardería, transporte, restaurante...
• Plan de formación continua a través de los cursos que tú elijas.
• Trabajar en un gran ambiente de trabajo: profesional y muy especializado.
• Formar parte de una empresa multinacional en pleno crecimiento a nivel nacional e internacional, dónde apostamos por la promoción interna según tus propios objetivos.

¡Te esperamos

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Java
jobs_results.description:
Centric Software is looking for a full-stack software engineer to join our development team. We are looking for a person who is eager to learn and eager to make a real contribution to our enterprise software products. We are looking for people who have a keen interest in creating software products that support our customer users in their daily work of developing their products for a highly competitive market.

As a full-stack software engineer, you will be expected to work effectively with a Product Manager and small development team to implement customer-requested product enhancements to the Centric 8 PLM system. You will contribute to all aspects of the software development lifecycle including story planning, iteration planning, exploring alternative solutions, implementing, and maintaining enterprise software solutions for Centric 8 PLM.

Job Summary:

You are a talented and highly motivated individual looking to join us in building our next-generation product platform.

You will... be a key part of an international, cross-functional team developing cutting-edge products using the latest and greatest tools.

You will help us build great things.

As our team grows, there is a big opportunity to contribute and advance your career.

To apply for this position please log into our website at

Responsibilities:

· Contribute substantially to the design and development of major components and sub-systems using Java platform

· Improve current architecture and design to meet the ever-increasing demand for performance and scalability
• Work with Product Management, QA, and documentation to deliver high-quality, complete Software Releases
• Contribute/help the company on the transition to move from a monolith to a Microservices ecosystem
• Contribute substantially to the design and development of major components and sub-systems using Java platform
• Improve current architecture and design to meet ever-increasing demand for performance and scalability

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science or a related field.
• 3+ years Experience in full-stack development
• AWS, Azure and/or Google Cloud
• Development Tools:
Bitbucket/Git, Jenkins, Junit, UML, JIRA
• Experience with responsive design and a deep understanding of Object-Oriented design
• Experience with performance debugging and benchmarking

What we offer:
• Competitive salary and benefits
• A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
• Opportunity to work remotely with a dedicated and motivated team
• A remote work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect
• Varied and challenging work to help you grow your technical skillset.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de Software .NET para proyecto en sector energía renovable.
jobs_results.description:
¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como .NET Developer en una empresa dedicada a ofrecer soluciones de ingeniería participando en el desarrollo de plataformas de control de energía renovable?

Desde Oxigent Technologies seleccionamos un/a BACKEND DEVELOPER con .NET para participar en un proyecto de desarrollo web ubicado en Asturias.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?
• Convertir las funcionalidades de negocio en especificaciones técnicas de software.
• Aportar en el proceso de desarrollo, mediante aportaciones personales al diseño, colaborando con el equipo de trabajo y haciendo seguimiento de los proveedores de desarrollo.
• Hacer la validación funcional del software, participando en la definición de pruebas y validaciones, realizando las mismas y sacando conclusiones.
• Transferencia de conocimiento para industrialización e implantación de soluciones
• Participar en los proyectos de innovación e investigación de nuevas tecnologías.
• Gestión y custodia de la... documentación del desarrollo de Software.

Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar?
• Formación: Grado Superior/Universitario en Ingeniería Informática o similares.
• Años de experiencia: al menos 3 años en proyectos de desarrollo de SW, IIoT, inteligencia artificial, ciberseguridad...
• Inglés nivel B2 o superior.
• Conocimientos en Tecnologías .NET.
• Conocimientos en Angular.
• Conocimientos básicos en infraestructuras en Azure Cloud.
• Conocimientos en protocolos de comunicación: MQTT.
• Conocimientos en S.O. Windows y Linux (Ubuntu) (Server).
• Creación y manejo de bases de datos SQL y NO SQL como MongoDB.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido a través de Oxigent.

Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada entre 32.000 y 35.000 € brutos/anuales.

Horario flexible.

Modelo trabajo presencial.

Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.

Seguro médico privado.

Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.

Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios con descuentos: apostamos por un estilo de vida saludable, por eso ofrecemos descuentos especiales en instalaciones de múltiples centros deportivos.

¡ Y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Desarrollador Senior
jobs_results.description:
Location: Sanz

Position Description

Rubicon

MD is an innovative healthcare company bringing better care at lower costs to providers and their patients across the country. Rubicon

MD’s mission is to ensure that all patients have access to the care they need, no matter who they are or where they live. It’s no small order, but we achieve it with the right team. That’s why we hire empathetic, passionate, and strong leaders who are looking to make an impact in the world through our core values:
Human, Agile, Innovative & Collaborative.

If you’re passionate about having a positive impact by revolutionizing the healthcare system and democratizing access to care, we’d love to learn more about you! Our engineering team is located across the US, primarily based in New York City, and throughout Spain.

Key responsibilities include:
• Champion end-to-end feature development with participation in system design & architecture, engineering implementation, software release, and technical... support
• Share and be open to learn from your peers via pair programming, technical writing, code reviews, architecture discussions, and active engagement with stakeholders
• Make explicit tradeoffs between technical implementation directions, and strive to clearly communicate to your peers what data drove you to make these choices
• Identify and advocate for opportunities to improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of technical stack and processes
• Build accessible, secure, and performant software solutions in a highly regulated healthcare environment. These may include on platform features, internal support tooling, mobile applications, and third party integrations

About our stack:

Everything's up for debate but we want to leave you with a good idea of what tools we are using today. While keeping our current tool box up to date, we are open minded about trying new technologies and ideas that may better fit our needs.

At the highest level, our Ruby on Rails backend is hosted in AWS with our Angular frontend being served through a CDN. We process tasks asynchronously and leverage a frontend cache to help reduce network calls against our Graph

QL APIs. Our Data Science team works off of a data lake, pulling data frames into python for reporting and analytics.

This is the general idea and we’re happy to jump into all the details with you!

Desired skills and experience:
• We are using the most recent version of Rails which means we hope you’ve had strong experience in Ruby or other object-oriented languages along with a deep understanding of the MVC pattern and how an ORM impacts SQL.
• When things get tough, we count on you to jump into the Rails console and our logs in Datadog and utilize your underlying experience in designing scalable applications.
• We favor reusability, and share libraries across projects. You should have opinions on defining and maintaining shared resources and both internal and external libraries.
• In delivering robust software, we expect you to bring some opinions about clean code, testability, and design patterns.
• We use Graph

QL as a query language for our API between frontend and backend. You should have experience utilizing APIs and designing contracts between engineering teams.

How we work:

We use scrum to organize into delivery teams which are autonomous, and responsible for holistically delivery features and pilots to our users. Our teams include fullstack, frontend, and backend engineers. We round out the team with a dedicated Scrum Master and Product Owner. These teams operate on a two-week sprint.

Additionally we have Dev Ops and Data Science teams providing support and insight across team functions.
Our Hiring Philosophy

Rubicon

MD’s founding mission is to democratize medical expertise, so that all patient populations have access to the care they need. In order to deliver on this, we focus on empowering primary care providers, who we believe are the key to a thriving, equitable health care system. It’s no small order, but we can achieve it with the right team. That’s why we hire people with drive and leadership, who are also highly accountable—to each other, to the providers we serve, and to the impact we exist to make.

Rubicon

MD is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination against persons of any kind on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, nation of origin, age, disability, and genetics.
• * COVID-19 vaccination is a condition of employment unless there is a legally protected reason for an accommodation.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

INNOVERY ¡Únete a nuestro equipo!

👉 Somos una Multinacional tecnológica que cuenta con 20 años de experiencia en todos los campos de las TIC, trabajando proyectos nacionales e internacionales.

🔍¿Qué buscamos?

Queremos seguir haciendo crecer nuestro talentoso equipo de B2B & Sustainability. Para ello, buscamos un perfil Junior Software Engineer B2B/MFT

📝 Funciones que llevarás a cabo:

Vas a tener la oportunidad de poner en práctica diversos conocimientos, trabajando en:
• Soporte de segundo nivel.
• Monitorización de la plataforma y gestión de incidencias en el entorno de producción del cliente.
• Desarrollo de procesos de negocio y gestión en la transferencia de ficheros (diferentes formatos tales como XML, CSV, Posicional, EDI, iDoc, etc.)
• Sistemas Operativos: mantenimiento de servidores, instalación y configuración de productos (docker containers).
• Configuración y gestión de protocolos de comunicación (FTP/S, SFTP, HTTP/S, AS2, email, C:D, web services, REST API... etc.).
• Securización: iniciación en encriptación, firma, autenticación, etc. tanto a nivel de comunicaciones como de tratamiento de ficheros.
• Definición de esquemas de bases de datos, gestión, optimización y actualizaciones.
• Instalaciones de productos en arquitecturas standalone o alta disponibilidad, on premise o IAAS.

✔️ Requisitos Indispensables:
• Formación: Grado en Ingeniería informática, Telecomunicaciones, Software o similar.
• Experiencia de 6 meses - 1 año en sector IT
• Conocimientos en:

-Bases de datos relacionales y jerárquicas

-Redes y protocolos de comunicación.

-Programación Orientada a Objetos (se valora experiencia en JAVA, .NET u otros lenguajes).

-Sistemas Operativos Unix, Linux y Windows.
• Inglés con nivel mínimo B2 (certificación no obligatoria)

➕ Requisitos Deseables (no imprescindibles):
• Experiencia trabajando en proyectos Business-to-Business (B2B) o Managed File Transfer (MFT) de 0 a 2 años.
• Hablar catalán será un Plus

Disponibilidades: Debido a los diferentes proyectos que tenemos y los países/ciudades con los que interactuamos, necesitamos:
• Disponibilidad para viajes.
• Disponibilidad para guardias.

💪Competencias:
• Proactividad.
• Capacidad de aprendizaje.
• Trabajo en equipo.
• Autonomía y responsabilidad.
• Adaptabilidad y flexibilidad.
• Enfoque a cliente.

🎯¿Qué ofrecemos?
• La oportunidad de pertenecer a una multinacional consolidada en el mercado con más de 20 años de experiencia y en crecimiento.
• Contrato indefinido y desarrollo profesional y personal.
• Remuneración atractiva, acorde a experiencia y conocimiento.
• Posibilidad de teletrabajo. Trabajamos en un sistema híbrido donde damos mayor peso al teletrabajo. Nuestra oficina siempre está disponible: C. ALMOGÀVERS, 107-115, BAIXOS | 08018 BARCELONA
• Flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano.
• Formarte en tecnologías punteras e innovadoras.
• Benefit Club de Innovery

Los datos personales se procesarán de acuerdo con las disposiciones contenidas en el reglamento de la UE 2016/679.

Lea la Política de privacidad de Innovery en el siguiente enlace:

https://innovery.net/it/privacy-policy/

Gracias por tu interés en INNOVERY

Location: Sanz

In the Center of Excellence Pricing and Analytics organization our mission is to deliver impact by building machine learning products to optimize pricing and marketing investments and provide guidance to HP's commercial sales organizations. Our team consists of a diverse global team of economists, statisticians, data scientists, data engineers, software engineers, Dev Ops, and MLOps engineers, who are pushing the innovation frontier to bring new insights to our business.

HP is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to considering all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. We steadfastly commit to crafting a diverse and inclusive work environment for all employees and strongly encourage women and underrepresented groups to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the development and implementation of software solutions.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and... deliver high-performance applications.

Apply best practices in software engineering, ensuring code quality and reliability.

Mentor junior team members and contribute to a culture of continuous learning.

Participate in architectural decisions and provide technical leadership.

Troubleshoot production bugs.

Be proactive to enhance current processes.

Document & help another team apply best practices.

Automate operational processes as needed.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.

Around 7 years of relevant experience in Software Development.

Strong knowledge in Back-End is essential (Node.js development, experience with asynchronous programming, event-driven architecture, and building scalable applications).

Experience with databases like Mongo

DB or Postgre

SQL.

Demonstrated working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git Hub workflows (i.e., pull requests, code merge).

Advanced verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to lead and mentor junior developers.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Ability to work independently under a fast-paced environment and deliver results under pressure.

Nice to Have:

Full Stack Developer with experience in both FE (React

JS) and BE (NodeJS/AWS Lambda).

Experience on cloud-based platform, i.e., AWS Cloud/Lambdas/Docker.

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Desarrollador Senior
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Staff Software Engineer

The Trade Desk is a global technology company with a mission to create a better, more open internet for everyone through principled, intelligent advertising. Handling over 1 trillion transactions per day, our platform operates at an unprecedented scale. We have also built something even stronger and more valuable: an award-winning culture based on trust, ownership, empathy, and collaboration. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Do you have a passion for solving hard problems at scale? Are you eager to join a dynamic, globally- connected team where your contributions will make a meaningful difference in building a better media ecosystem? Come and see why Fortune magazine consistently ranks The Trade Desk among the best small- to medium-sized workplaces globally.

What we do:

Our... Staff engineers are the end-to-end owners who drive the process of designing, building, and deploying extracting insights from petabytes of data to help our clients makes data driven decisions to grow their businesses.

You will be building a forecasting solution which provides real time responses while operating on a trillion-records-a-day dataset. We often find that off-the-shelf products and approaches struggle with our volumes of data and that is the main challenge and source of fun you will have. The forecasting system our team operates is the backbone of a lot of TTD features and at the core of our business model.

Our system performs every day, 24/7, serving global traffic. We build a distributed system in a highly collaborative environment, utilizing a broad range of technologies. Our data engineers work on finding solutions to algorithmic, optimization, and scale challenges in everything we do.

What you’ll do:

You will act as a technical leader on multi-month, multi-person projects. You will work closely with many stakeholders to understand the Why behind products you will be building and use this knowledge to drive your engineering decisions and instil this understanding on the team.

You will own products end to end: design, implementation and deployment to cloud levering internal tools developed by cloud and IaaS teams at TTD.

You will serve as an example to junior engineers and help them grow faster by providing guidance in MR reviews and sharing your knowledge.

Who you are:
• You have a track record of technical leadership on multi-month, multi-engineer projects with high level of ambiguity
• You like to engage with stakeholders and help engineers in the team understand the “why” behind the work
• You are a generalist with focus on working with big datasets (tens of of Tb) using technologies like Spark and building backend applications in languages like Java, C# or Scala exposing REST or gRPC APIs
• You are able to think about performance and inspect running the production system to understand if its performance is CPU, Memory, Disk or Network bound
• You worked with SQL databases and you are a confident user of SQL language
• You have experience in deploying containerised software. Ideally you have experience with Kubernetes or you are a confident user of docker and have grasp on docker internals
• Ideally you worked with column-oriented databases, e.g. Vertica or Click House
• You worked within cloud environment
• You are familiar with Linux and able to use shell
• You can efficiently debug problems with multi-component system (e.g. Spark Job with custom code on EMR driven by Airflow did not complete, what happened?)
• You are an open person ready to share your knowledge with other team members via MR reviews or other forums
• You work with confidence and without ego. Our engineers have deep knowledge and exercise a high degree of leadership in their daily work. You have strong opinions that are weakly held, defensible ideas, and advocate for what you believe is right. You are also adept at identifying and evaluating trade-offs, willing to be proven wrong, and quick to walk through fire to support your fellow teammates.
• You value, seek out, and foster diversity. We are a global team from many diverse backgrounds, with different experiences and perspectives. To complement this team, you will welcome ideas that are different from your own and be skilled at finding and building from common ground.

What you know is less important than how well you learn and innovate. We don't need engineers who know all the answers; we need engineers who can invent the answers no one has thought of yet, to the questions yet to be asked. What and how you can contribute is what’s important to us. Our consideration is not limited by the kind of education you have or the specific technologies you have experience with.

Variety of technical challenge is one of the best things about working at The Trade Desk as an engineer, but we do not expect you to know every technology we use when you start. What we care about is that…

jobs_results.company_name: 481T SIEMENS GAMESA RENEWABLE ENERGY INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY S.L.
jobs_results.description:
Location: Zamudio

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team.
Designs, implements, maintains, enhances, tests, and supports software.

SGRE has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet.

We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the company. SGRE is an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In our culture of trust we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is what makes us... one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization.

How to contribute to our vision

For our SW development team within the SCADA department, we are looking for an ambitious and dedicated Software Developer. The SCADA team is a part of the bigger Power Plant Solutions department with employees in Spain, Denmark, Germany and India.

Going forward we are aiming for a microservice-oriented architecture connected by a middleware layer and taking advantage of containerization. The software development follows agile methods and continuous delivery principles.

Your tasks and responsibilities include:
• New development and maintenance of our products and supporting tools
• Software development following agile methods and under continuous delivery principles (SAFe)
• Prepare documentation in English

What you need to make a difference

Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change. We are looking for you, who wants to make real what matters and who wants to change the world to renewable energy.

The ideal candidate holds an academic degree related to Computer Science, SW Engineering or System Engineering in combination with e xtensive knowledge and working experience (5+ years) in:
• Visual Studio, C#, .NET and .Net Core
• Web development:
Angular
• Unit testing and behavior driven development
• Object oriented analysis and design

It will be an advantage if you also have knowledge of the following:
• Git/Git Lab
• Client/server systems & SQL
• Docker/Kubernetes
• REST APIs (JSON)
• Cyber-security or secure development principles
• Scaled Agile development (SCRUM/SAFe)
• Good English skills .

Most importantly, you challenge yourself and your colleagues to achieve the best results. You have a high professional competency and you have a desire to develop your skills. You have good collaboration skills and you can manage to act in different cultural contexts. To thrive in this position, you must have a strong result-oriented approach.

In return of your commitment, we offer you…

Become a part of our mission for sustainability:
Clean energy for generations to come. We are a global team of diverse colleagues who share a passion for renewable energy and have a culture of trust and empowerment to make our own ideas a reality. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization. SGRE offers a wide variety of benefits such as flexible working hours as well as home-office possibility for many colleagues, attractive remuneration package (fixed/variable) and local benefits such as subsidized lunch, employee discounts and much more.

Empowering our people

How do you imagine the future?

Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face.

Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a work environment that is free from discrimination and where employees are treated with dignity and respect. Employment at Siemens Gamesa is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to job competence. Siemens Gamesa does not discriminate against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, ethnicity, nationality, ancestry, genetic information, citizenship, religion, age, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, rules or regulations.

We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits.

We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working.

With a worldwide installed capacity of 124 GW, Siemens Gamesa Renewable…

SGRE has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet.

We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the company. SGRE is an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In our culture of trust we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is what makes us... one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization.

How to contribute to our vision

For our SW development team within the SCADA department, we are looking for an ambitious and dedicated Software Developer. The SCADA team is a part of the bigger Power Plant Solutions department with employees in Spain, Denmark, Germany and India.

Going forward we are aiming for a microservice-oriented architecture connected by a middleware layer and taking advantage of containerization. The software development follows agile methods and continuous delivery principles.

Your tasks and responsibilities include:
• New development and maintenance of our products and supporting tools
• Software development following agile methods and under continuous delivery principles (SAFe)
• Prepare documentation in English

What you need to make a difference

Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change. We are looking for you, who wants to make real what matters and who wants to change the world to renewable energy.

The ideal candidate holds an academic degree related to Computer Science, SW Engineering or System Engineering in combination with e xtensive knowledge and working experience (5+ years) in:
• Visual Studio, C#, .NET and .Net Core
• Web development:
Angular
• Unit testing and behavior driven development
• Object oriented analysis and design

It will be an advantage if you also have knowledge of the following:
• Git/Git Lab
• Client/server systems & SQL
• Docker/Kubernetes
• REST APIs (JSON)
• Cyber-security or secure development principles
• Scaled Agile development (SCRUM/SAFe)
• Good English skills .

Most importantly, you challenge yourself and your colleagues to achieve the best results. You have a high professional competency and you have a desire to develop your skills. You have good collaboration skills and you can manage to act in different cultural contexts. To thrive in this position, you must have a strong result-oriented approach.

In return of your commitment, we offer you…

Become a part of our mission for sustainability:
Clean energy for generations to come. We are a global team of diverse colleagues who share a passion for renewable energy and have a culture of trust and empowerment to make our own ideas a reality. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization. SGRE offers a wide variety of benefits such as flexible working hours as well as home-office possibility for many colleagues, attractive remuneration package (fixed/variable) and local benefits such as subsidized lunch, employee discounts and much more.

Empowering our people

How do you imagine the future?

Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face.

We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits.

We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working.
